parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Square $x+iy$, simplify using $i^2=-1$, and equate real and imaginary parts to 24 and $-7$. [M1] Obtain $x^2-y^2=24$ and $2xy=-7$. [A1] Eliminate one variable correctly to obtain an equation in only the other, with all powers positive and in the numerator. [M1] Obtain $4x^4-96x^2-49=0$ or $4y^4+96y^2-49=0$, or a three-term equivalent. [A1] Obtain exactly the two paired roots $\frac{7\sqrt2}{2}-\frac{\sqrt2}{2}i$ and $-\frac{7\sqrt2}{2}+\frac{\sqrt2}{2}i$, with no others; the printed pairing restrictions apply and $\sqrt{49}$ must be simplified. [A1] Total: 5.
